"text": "Every year, review each relevant insurance policy for coverage amount, premium status, ownership, beneficiary designations, cash value or loan activity if applicable, policy performance, and continued fit with the client’s financial plan. Note any changes in family status, retirement income needs, estate planning goals, or tax considerations that may require carrier or attorney coordination.\n\nReview Elena Mossbutton’s Silver Marmot Insurance policies and provider list against the Fort Collins household setup and note any updates needed.",

"assigneeId": null,
"subTasks": [],

},
{
"templateId": "a9d3b8a3-fcdf-5a99-bb86-dc976b2554d7",
"title": "Complete beneficiary update checklist",
"text": "Use this checklist before submitting or recording beneficiary updates:\n\n- Confirm the account registration and account type requiring a beneficiary review.\n- Verify current primary and contingent beneficiaries on file.\n- Confirm full legal names, relationships, dates of birth if required, and allocation percentages.\n- Check that total primary percentages equal 100% and total contingent percentages equal 100% when applicable.\n- Identify whether spouse consent, trust documentation, or plan administrator approval is required.\n- Confirm whether IRA, retirement plan, transfer-on-death, insurance, or annuity rules apply.\n- Send the correct custodian or carrier form through the approved secure process.\n- Save confirmation of submission and final acceptance in the client record.\n- Note any estate planning follow‑up needed with the client’s attorney.\n\nConduct a consolidated review of Elena Mossbutton’s IRA, TOD note, and Silver Marmot life policy to update beneficiary contacts and coordinate with the attorney, completing the work by August 8, 2025.",
"priority": "high",
"dueDate": "2025-08-08",
"assigneeId": null,
"subTasks": [],
"evidence": "Mira’s relocation review found that the IRA, taxable transfer-on-death note, and Silver Marmot Insurance life policy still reference the Oregon trust documents and Lara Thimblefern as successor contact; the agreed beneficiary and estate-document alignment work covers a consolidated review of household beneficiary records and attorney coordination notes by 2025-08-08."
